responsibility: This definition module is the main GNU Modula-2 foreign-function interface to the host C standard and POSIX-style library. It belongs to the low-level runtime interop layer and exports raw bindings for process control, memory allocation, file descriptors and vectored I/O, environment access, time structures and queries, terminal naming, random numbers, string and memory primitives, shutdown/rename/exec, and setjmp/longjmp support, along with C data structures such as tm and timeb that other gm2 runtime modules consume.
